sections.title: Review status
sections.sql: select p.code period,p.status,p.currency,s.prepared_by,s.approved_by,(s.revision<>p.revision) stale from statements s join periods p on p.id=s.period_id where s.id=$1
sections.note: Private working paper. No payment instruction, tax calculation or recipient delivery.

sections.title: Retained calculation inputs
sections.sql: select snapshot from statements where id=$1

sections.title: Imported reports
sections.sql: select code,name,source,fingerprint,actor from imports where period_id=$1

sections.title: Recorded totals
sections.sql: select reseller,territory,sum(units) units,sum(net_amount) net_amount from sales where period_id=$1 group by reseller,territory

sections.title: Unfinished actions
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_on from actions where period_id=$1 and result is null

sections.title: Projected recoupment
sections.note: Provisional. Source checks and earlier period closure must clear before statement approval. No payment instruction.
sections.sql: select period,currency,earned_amount,opening_amount,cost_amount,recouped_amount,closing_amount,available_amount from v_recoupment where contract_id=$1 order by period

sections.title: Saved statement reviews
sections.sql: select code,revision,prepared_by,approved_by from statements where contract_id=$1
